name: Sakanaya
title: Dokkai Dojo
lead: JLPT reading drills N5-N1 set at a fictional neighborhood fish shop: an opening-hours notice, a first day helping at the shop, a product price guide, a fish-cutting workshop notice, a new-staff training plan comparison, a story about noticing a regular customer's change through good service, a lesson teaching a new part-timer the basics of handling fish, an explainer on why the shop still goes to the market every morning, a home-delivery service application guide, a column on how more supermarket fish changed the shop's work, a year-end-season order rule, a column on the meaning of a craftsman's fish-judging skill, and a one-year neighborhood fish-shop-association cooperation report. Original texts, answers with the reason for every choice.
